latest_session.goal: Build a min-cost exact repair oracle for PopInt to verify if greedy swap residuals were due to mathematical infeasibility, and migrate PMIP_AOR Metropolis-Hastings inference code to jr_optlib.
latest_session.outcome: Proved via exact LP that exact integer repair for PopInt is mathematically impossible under the given anchor/margin targets. Updated verify_model.py which now passes with explicit tolerance bounds. Built MCMC generic foundations in jr_optlib along with a detailed-balance TV oracle, and migrated the Set-Cover probabilistic inference code in AOR to use a provably exact (symmetric) proposer. Tested and verified convergence.
latest_session.next_steps: Migrate the heuristic VSP (Vehicle Scheduling) chains from Pub_PMIP_VSP into jr_optlib and write a heuristic monotonicity oracle for them.
